_comment: Tier-2 for skfem hydraulic_resistance#2, verified 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1 / scipy 1.15.3. The entry as previously written said the Stokes saddle point has a 1-D constant-pressure null space, that 'without pinning one pressure DOF the solver fails -- direct LU gets SingularMatrix', and that the signal is MatrixRankWarning('Matrix is exactly singular') or an all-NaN solve. Ran: the shipped channel geometry -- Taylor-Hood ElementVector(P2)/P1 on a 41x7 MeshTri.init_tensor, 2106 velocity and 287 pressure DOFs, no-slip walls, inlet pressure traction as a natural BC -- solved with and without the outlet pressure pin; then the same assembly with velocity constrained all the way round; then a structurally singular scipy matrix and the equal-order P1/P1 pair. Printed: THE PREMISE IS WRONG FOR THIS TEMPLATE -- nullity is 0 both pinned and unpinned, dropping the pin changes the flow rate by 1.667e-13 relative and the velocity by 1.353e-15, and both give resistance 2.400000e+04. The inlet traction sets the pressure level; the pin only puts p=0 at the outlet. The null space IS real for ENCLOSED flow (nullity exactly 1) but there scipy emits NOTHING -- empty warning record, no exception, finite solution -- so a catch-MatrixRankWarning guard cannot fire and isfinite passes too. The warning is genuine and fires on a structurally zero pivot and on the inf-sup-violating equal-order pair, and in BOTH of those the result is non-finite, which is why isfinite is the right partner there and useless here.
